requirements.title: Deterministic Editor Ops
requirements.description: All deterministic editing ops (resize, crop, rotate/flip/straighten/deskew, format convert, compress/optimize incl. target file size, adjustments, filters/effects, canvas, composite/overlay, thumbnail, metadata) run zero-download and instant from the CLI with no UI and no ComfyUI.

validation.notes: Each op transforms pixels/metadata correctly with deterministic output
Headless CLI runs every deterministic op end-to-end with no UI/ComfyUI present
Fresh machine acceptance: all deterministic ops succeed from CLI offline
